title: Pizza Burgers
description: A cheesy, saucy ground beef mixture with melted Velveeta and pizza flavors. Pile it on hamburger buns for an easy crowd-pleasing dinner.
ingredients: 1 can spaghetti sauce with meat (11 oz)
instructions: Brown ground beef with oregano, diced onion, and green pepper in a large skillet. Drain fat.
Add cubed Velveeta cheese to the skillet and stir over low heat until melted.
Stir in spaghetti sauce and tomato paste. Mix until well combined and heated through.
